email.heading: Change email
email.description: A confirmation link will be sent to the new address. The email will only change after you follow it.

phone.heading: Phone number
phone.linkDescription: Link your phone number — it is the primary way to sign in. We will send an SMS with a confirmation code.
phone.changeHint: Primary sign-in method. To change the number, please contact support.

emailLogin.heading: Email sign-in
emailLogin.description: An additional way to sign in. Enter an email and a password — we will send a confirmation link; email sign-in starts working after you follow it.
emailLogin.pending: Awaiting confirmation: {{email}}. Follow the link in the email — or enter another address below.
emailLogin.phoneFirst: Link a phone number first to set up email sign-in.
emailLogin.codeSent: We sent a confirmation code to {{phone}}

socials.heading: Social networks
socials.description: Add links to your profiles. The address must be absolute (start with http:// or https://). Clear a field to remove the link.

validation.passwordSameAsCurrent: New password must differ from current
validation.socialUrlInvalid: Enter a full address starting with http:// or https://

toast.passwordChanged: Password changed. Please sign in again.
toast.emailChangeFallback: Check your new email to confirm the change

placeholder.comingSoon: This section will be available after server support is added.

banner.phoneRequired: Link your phone number — it is now the primary way to sign in.

welcome.signUp: Your account is ready! Fill in your profile — your full name is needed for show entries and documents.
welcome.signIn: A new account was created for this number. If you previously signed up with email, sign out, sign in with email and link your phone under Security.
